methodology.hypothesis: Test covariance-only diversification without sector satellites,return forecasts or new macro gates. All four existing style ETFs and both gold/intermediate Treasury defense assets remain positively allocated. This changes portfolio construction,not the economic factor catalog.
methodology.covariance: At each completed NYSE month end use exactly252prior observed daily total returns including that close,sample covariance times252,then10%shrinkage toward its diagonal. These lengths/shrinkage were already used in prior allocation research;no covariance/lookback grid or future normalization.
methodology.risk_budget: Minimize0.5*x'Cx minus the meanlog of strictly positive unnormalized allocations under homogeneous group constraints,then normalize. Equal one-sixth target risk budgets motivate the objective,but binding equity/style/defense constraints can prevent exact equal risk contribution;report actual signed risk shares and deviations rather than label them equal.
methodology.maximum_diversification: Use the equivalent convex minimum-variance formulation with weighted standalone volatility fixed toone and the same homogeneous group constraints,then normalize. This maximizes the diversification ratio of the selected actual assets,not expected return or measured Sharpe.
methodology.constraints: Equity receives30%-70%of invested capital;each style receives15%-35%of equity,retaining prior bounds. Gold and IEF each receive25%-75%of defense,a symmetric half-to-one-and-a-half equal-share constraint fixed before targets/outcomes. Invest98%with2%target idle cash;SPY is only the benchmark and BIL is only available cash implementation,neither enters the risk optimizer.
methodology.execution: Only completed month-end targets,no daily volatility target,breadth filter,pending-order overlay,shorting or leverage. Original independentUSD10000capital,5bpnext-openbase,20bpextra-sessionstress,USD1/order,and exact10y/5ywindows remain. All targets/fees/failures count.
methodology.source: Reuse the original verified eight-asset market panels/issuer mandates with a new actual readiness check,not new acquisitions or historical constituent reconstruction. PrimaryCrossref confirms both papers'identities,not inaccessible fulltexts,abstracts,exactreplications or publishedperformance;the unicode-author validator failure is separately preserved.
methodology.selection: Two fixed construction hypotheses formed after120strategytrials and full-cohort component diagnostics on exposed history. Do not derive factor removal/weights from those diagnostics or retune after outcomes. Neither historical acceptance nor a newlabel creates independentforwardevidence;oldselectionbootstraps do not include these trials.
methodology.risk: Equitystyles still share beta/stocks;correlations,riskpremia and Treasury/gold behavior can change. Covariance-only allocation without leverage may sacrificeCAGR;bounds do not guarantee15%drawdown orSharpe>1. Optimizererrors/invalidcovariance must explicitly stop,no equalweight fallback.
methodology.future_queue: This existing-factor construction study does not register economic definitions or alter the original fourW42plans/IJRPKWquota. Original forward rules remain frozen;new winners cannot automatically replace them.
